tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Ambient page base — the warm-grey paper everything sits on. Carries the dot grid.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background, card, popover, muted and every surface rung.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Content surface — cards, panels, tables. White in light, darker than background in dark.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dropdown panels.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default button fill, checked controls, active switch. Near-black ink in light, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Inset fills — tab lists, metadata rows, skeletons. Deepest fill in dark for maximum text contrast.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, captions on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fills and selected rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive actions; used at 10–20% as the destructive button fill. Also --status-error.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet surface.

tokens.name: overlay-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on overlay.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and sheets.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for cards, dividers, tables — 6% ink, never a hard grey.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input border; inputs and outline buttons fill with input at 30%.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour — 3px ring at 50% on focus-visible.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Surface-elevation rung P7 — card/panel surface for elevation-aware layouts.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Rung P11 — neutral containers, grouped content.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Rung P17 — menus and toasts above overlay.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Rung P2 — deepest surface: media wells, splash.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Rung P3 — app shell behind base.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and navigation rail background.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Sidebar hover fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar dividers.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Per-brand saturated accent for CTAs and highlights. The registry default is gold (deep amber in light, honey in dark); mukoko maps it to tanzanite, bundu to copper — consumer apps override it.

tokens.name: brand-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on brand-accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / positive state (malachite). Also --status-success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state (amber). Also --status-warning.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state (cobalt). Also --status-info.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral / inactive status, secondary data series. Also --status-neutral.

tokens.name: offline
tokens.usage: Offline connectivity state.

tokens.name: syncing
tokens.usage: Syncing / in-flight state.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — tanzanite mineral.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — cobalt mineral.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — malachite mineral.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 — gold mineral.

tokens.name: chart-5

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Mineral · Knowledge — Primary blue, links, CTAs. Digital future, trust, knowledge.

tokens.name: cobalt-container
tokens.usage: Soft cobalt fill behind cobalt-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: cobalt-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cobalt-container.

tokens.name: tanzanite
tokens.usage: Mineral · Identity — Purple accent, brand/logo, social features. Premium, creativity, connection.

tokens.name: tanzanite-container
tokens.usage: Soft tanzanite fill behind tanzanite-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: tanzanite-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tanzanite-container.

tokens.name: malachite
tokens.usage: Mineral · Growth — Success states, positive actions. Growth, nature, success.

tokens.name: malachite-container
tokens.usage: Soft malachite fill behind malachite-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: malachite-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on malachite-container.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Mineral · Value — Achievements, rewards, highlights. Honey, rewards, warmth.

tokens.name: gold-container
tokens.usage: Soft gold fill behind gold-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: gold-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold-container.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Mineral · Community — Community features, warmth. Earth, community, grounding.

tokens.name: terracotta-container
tokens.usage: Soft terracotta fill behind terracotta-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: terracotta-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on terracotta-container.

tokens.name: sodalite
tokens.usage: Mineral · Intelligence — AI/Shamwari surfaces, deep-reasoning states. Intelligence, depth, reasoning. Contrast: 3.73:1 on card in dark — large text and marks only in dark; body text uses sodalite-on-container on sodalite-container.

tokens.name: sodalite-container
tokens.usage: Soft sodalite fill behind sodalite-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: sodalite-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sodalite-container.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Mineral · Stewardship — Bundu ecosystem identity, the commons. Connection, foundation, stewardship. Contrast: 4.44:1 on card in light — use at 18.66px+ bold / 24px+, or for fills and marks; body text in copper goes on copper-container via copper-on-container.

tokens.name: copper-container
tokens.usage: Soft copper fill behind copper-on-container text: chips, callouts, selected states.

tokens.name: copper-on-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on copper-container.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Twilight surfaces, deep atmosphere, mini-app moods. Dusk, depth, the dyer's craft. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour.

tokens.name: savanna
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Warm grassland surfaces, daylight atmosphere. Sun-dried grass, open land, the dry season. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour.

tokens.name: baobab
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Earthy surfaces, grounded atmosphere, bark tones. The tree of life, age, shelter. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour.

tokens.name: sunset
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Warm accent surfaces, golden-hour atmosphere. Day's end, warmth, the gathering hour. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour. Contrast: 4.44:1 on card in light — large text and marks only.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Cool surfaces, flowing atmosphere, water tones. Flow, life, the journey. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour.

tokens.name: hematite
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Neutral anchor, mini-app surfaces, atmosphere. Foundation, endurance, the substrate. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour.

tokens.name: kalahari
tokens.usage: Heritage tone — Light anchor, warm backgrounds, mini-app surfaces. Openness, space, the light pole. Atmospheric, not a UI state colour. Contrast: 2.01:1 on card in light — never text in light; a background/atmosphere tone.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Secondary hero headlines, landing page sub-hero sections Fluid 36–60px.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Nested headings in long-form content, legal pages, deep documentation

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav items, UI labels needing emphasis without semibold weight. Fills gap between body (400) and semibold (600) — used for active nav states, form labels, and table headers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, terminal output Font features: tabular-nums.

spacing.note: Ecosystem spacing scale. Default component padding is space-base; comfortable is space-base-plus.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps — chip-in-chip, icon-to-badge, inline meta separators

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, icon padding

tokens.name: space-xs-plus
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text offset, tight inline spacing

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Compact spacing, inline gaps

tokens.name: space-sm-plus
tokens.usage: Dense tag padding, compact button icons

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Compact component padding — dense layouts, secondary surfaces

tokens.name: space-base
tokens.usage: Default component padding — cards, inputs, comfortable density

tokens.name: space-base-plus
tokens.usage: Comfortable component padding — the modern SaaS default (Linear, Vercel, Stripe)

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Section padding, card gaps

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Page margins, large gaps

tokens.name: space-xl-plus
tokens.usage: Section-header-to-content gap, large card spacing

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Section margins

tokens.name: space-2xl-plus
tokens.usage: Between major content blocks

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Page section spacing

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Page section spacing on desktop — hero breathing room

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Hero section spacing — prominent landing blocks

tokens.name: space-6xl
tokens.usage: Page hero spacing — full-viewport feature sections

radius.note: Ecosystem numbers: 7, 12, 14, 17. Buttons are always pill (rounded-full).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 1× unit. Checkboxes, small chips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Unit + 5. Inner corners of card headers/footers, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: 2× unit — THE card radius; also the base --radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Unit + 10. Dialogs, vertical tab lists.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill: every button, input, switch and horizontal tab list. Brand identity decision.

size.note: Touch targets and control heights (APCA 3.0 AAA).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target — small buttons, inputs, icon-sm buttons.

tokens.name: touch-default
tokens.usage: Default touch target — default and large buttons, horizontal tab lists.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring width, drawn in ring at 50% (focus-visible:ring-[3px] in the N2 primitives).

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Body dot-grid pitch (1px dots in dot-color).

aspect.note: Media aspect ratios. Square is the default.

tokens.name: aspect-media
tokens.usage: Default for every media surface and detail-page hero.

tokens.name: aspect-media-wide
tokens.usage: Only for intrinsically 16:9 media (video frames) — never to make a layout look better.

tokens.name: aspect-media-portrait
tokens.usage: Portrait media: profiles, covers.
